snapshot.source:
MEZZOLOTH COMPANY CR 20
A clacking horde of insectile mercenaries, reeking of
brimstone with an undertone of something worse beneath.
AC 18 (natural armor)
HP 225 (30d8 + 90)
Speed 40 ft.
Initiative +6 (16)
Size Huge (Swarm of
Medium)
Type Fiend (Yugoloth)
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
STR 18 +4 +4 DEX 11 +0 +0 CON 16 +3 +3
INT 7 -2 -2 WIS 14 +2 +2 CHA 10 +0 +0
Resistances Fire; Damage from Attacks
Immunities Acid, Poison; Charmed, Frightened, Grappled,
Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 12
Languages Abyssal, Infernal, Telepathy 60 ft.
Drives Advertise Services, Collect Loot, Escalate Conflict
XP 25,000 Proficiency Bonus +6
Traits
Conniving Resistance. The company has Advantage on
Saving Throws against spells and other magical effects.
It always appears to fail any Intelligence or Wisdom
Saving Throws.
Swarm. The company can occupy another creature’s
space and vice versa, and can move through any opening
large enough for a single mezzoloth.
Actions
Multiattack. The company makes one attack and uses its
Weaverot Volley.
Spindly Shred. Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 0 ft. Hit: 49
(10d8 + 4) Slashing damage, or half as much damage if
the company is Bloodied, and the target is Grappled
(escape DC 18).
A creature Grappled in this way can attempt to escape as
a Bonus Action.
Weaverot Volley. A volley of barbed spines sails forth,
leaving trails of ruined magic in their wake.
Each creature in a 15-foot radius Sphere within 60 feet
must make a DEXTERITY SAVING THROW: DC 18. FAILURE: 14
(4d6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.
SUCCESS OR FAILURE: Each spell of Level 2 or below affecting
the creature ends.
Bonus Actions
Toxic Emission. Clouds of stinging gas hiss from the
company, forcing each creature within 10 feet of it to
make a CONSTITUTION SAVING THROW: DC 17. FAILURE: 18 (4d8)
Poison damage and the creature is Blinded until the end
of its next turn. SUCCESS: Half damage.
Strike-Gate (1/Day). The company teleports to a space
within 120 feet. Any creature Grappled by it must make a
CHARISMA SAVING THROW: DC 16. FAILURE: The creature
teleports with the company.

Multiattack. The company makes one attack and uses its

of its next turn. SUCCESS: Half damage.

within 120 feet. Any creature Grappled by it must make a
CHARISMA SAVING THROW: DC 16. FAILURE: The creature
teleports with the company.
